mainEntity.name: How much does a BMW 3 Series 324d engine replacement cost in the UK?

acceptedAnswer.text: A BMW 3 Series 324d engine replacement typically costs between £800 and £4,500 supply-only, depending on the condition type. Used engines: £800-£1,800. Reconditioned engines: £1,800-£3,200. Rebuilt engines: £2,500-£4,500 with 12-month warranty. Supply and fit adds approximately £1,000-£1,500 in labour due to the age and specialist knowledge required for the M21D24.

mainEntity.name: Was the BMW 324d ever sold in the UK?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, the BMW 324d was never officially offered in the UK market. However, a number of cars were privately imported from mainland Europe and converted to right-hand drive. This makes the 324d a rare sight on British roads and adds to its desirability as a classic BMW today.

mainEntity.name: Does the BMW 324d have a timing chain or timing belt?

acceptedAnswer.text: The BMW 324d's M21D24 engine uses a timing belt, not a chain. This is a critical distinction from modern BMW diesel engines like the N47 and B47, which use chains. The timing belt must be replaced every 40,000-60,000 miles or 5-6 years - failure is catastrophic and will destroy the engine.

mainEntity.name: Is it worth replacing the engine in a BMW 3 Series 324d?

acceptedAnswer.text: The BMW 324d is a rare classic with only 75,696 examples ever built. A typical 324d in good condition is worth £5,000-£15,000 depending on originality and condition. For a cherished example, a rebuilt engine with warranty is a sound investment that preserves the car's value. For cars in poorer condition, a used engine or repair may be more appropriate.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between the BMW 324d and 324td?

acceptedAnswer.text: The 324d is naturally aspirated with 86 bhp, while the 324td (introduced in 1987) added a turbocharger, increasing power to 115 bhp. Both share the same M21D24 engine block, but the 324td has a turbocharger, different injector pump calibration, and lower compression ratio. The 324td is rarer - only 21,514 were produced compared to 75,696 324d units.

mainEntity.name: Does a rebuilt BMW 3 Series 324d engine come with a warranty?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Every rebuilt BMW 3 Series 324d engine supplied through EnginesMarket comes with a minimum 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty as standard. The warranty covers manufacturing defects and parts failure. Upgraded components address the original failure points. Always confirm exact warranty terms with your chosen supplier.

historyTimeline.h2: BMW 3 Series 324d - Engine History & Specs at a Glance
historyTimeline.intro: The BMW 324d marked a milestone for the 3 Series - it was the first six-cylinder diesel ever offered in a BMW 3 Series when it launched in 1985. Built on the E30 generation, the 324d used BMW's M21 diesel engine - a 2.4-litre naturally aspirated six-cylinder that delivered 86 bhp and remarkable fuel economy for its era. Though never officially sold in the UK, a number of private imports have found their way to British roads, making the 324d a rare and distinctive classic BMW today.

milestones.description: M21D24, 2.4-litre naturally aspirated six-cylinder diesel (86 bhp) - E30 generation launched

commonProblems.h2: BMW 3 Series 324d Engine Problems - Repair Cost vs Replacement
commonProblems.h3: The BMW 3 Series 324d's M21D24 six-cylinder diesel is a robust, under-stressed engine from the 1980s - but age takes its toll. Timing belt failure is the single biggest risk, while injector pump leaks and cold-start issues are the most common day-to-day frustrations. Rebuilt engines through EnginesMarket include upgraded components addressing the original failure points, plus a minimum 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

problems.h4: Timing Belt Failure - Why the BMW 3 Series 324d M21D24 Engine Needs Regular Belt Changes
problems.rootCause: The M21D24 uses a rubber timing belt, not a chain. Unlike modern BMW diesel engines with chains, the belt is a service item that must be replaced at regular intervals. If the belt snaps, the engine's valves and pistons collide - catastrophic damage requiring a full rebuild or replacement.

problems.h4: Injector Pump & Cold-Start Issues - Why the BMW 3 Series 324d Struggles to Start in Winter
problems.rootCause: The M21D24 uses a Bosch VE mechanical injection pump. Over time, seals degrade, allowing air ingress or fuel leaks. The indirect injection system with pre-combustion chambers also suffers carbon buildup, reducing cold-start performance.
